CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.P.source:
theorem disjoint_point_predicates (hi : diag U ≫ δ = 𝟙 U)
    (hd : δ ≫ diag U = RestrictionCategory.rst δ) :
    ∃ (p q : Z.obj ⟶ U) (P N : Idem U), isTotal p ∧ isTotal q ∧ P ⊓ N = ⊥ ∧
      p ≫ P.hom = p ∧ q ≫ N.hom = q := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hid⟩ := exists_code hZ τ hτ (𝟙 U)
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hz⟩ := exists_code hZ τ hτ (0 : U ⟶ U)
  let P := pointPredicate hZ δ p
  let N := pointPredicate hZ δ q
  let c := P ⊓ N
  refine ⟨p,q,P,N,hp,hq,?_,pointPredicate_fixed hZ δ hp hi,pointPredicate_fixed hZ δ hq hi⟩
  have ep := pointPredicate_restriction hZ δ hp hd c (show c ≤ P from inf_le_left)
  have en := pointPredicate_restriction hZ δ hq hd c (show c ≤ N from inf_le_right)
  have hzero := apart_codes hZ τ hp hid hz (c.hom ≫ terminate hZ U) (by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using ep.symm.trans en)
  apply Idem.ext
  change c.hom = 0
  rw [ep,← Category.assoc,hzero,zero_comp]

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.P.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ProgramOrder.exists_inseparable
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.P.source:
theorem exists_inseparable (hne : ∃ X : C, 𝟙 X ≠ (0 : X ⟶ X))
    (joins : CompatibleJoinsPreservedByPrecomposition C) (δ : nearProd U U ⟶ U)
    (hi : diag U ≫ δ = 𝟙 U) (hd : δ ≫ diag U = RestrictionCategory.rst δ) :
    ∃ a b : Idem U, a ⊓ b = ⊥ ∧
      ¬ ∃ c n : Idem U, PairComplementary c n ∧ a ≤ c ∧ b ≤ n := by
  obtain ⟨p,q,P,N,hp,hq,hPN,hpP,hqN⟩ := disjoint_point_predicates hZ τ hτ δ hi hd
  let D := diag U ≫ τ
  refine ⟨Idem.pull D P,Idem.pull D N,by rw [← Idem.pull_inf,hPN,Idem.pull_bot],?_⟩
  rintro ⟨c,n,hcn,hc,hn⟩
  obtain ⟨j,hc',hn'⟩ := branches joins c n hcn.disjoint (terminate hZ U ≫ q) (terminate hZ U ≫ p)
    (RestrictionCategory.isTotal_comp (terminate_total hZ U) hq)
    (RestrictionCategory.isTotal_comp (terminate_total hZ U) hp)
  obtain ⟨k,hk,hj⟩ := exists_code hZ τ hτ j
  have ha : Idem.pull k c ≤ Idem.pull k n :=
    (switched_fibre hZ τ c hq hk N hqN j hj hc').trans (Idem.pull_mono k hn)
  have hb : Idem.pull k n ≤ Idem.pull k c :=
    (switched_fibre hZ τ n hp hk P hpP j hj hn').trans (Idem.pull_mono k hc)
  have hempty : Idem.pull k c ⊓ Idem.pull k n = ⊥ := by rw [← Idem.pull_inf,hcn.disjoint,Idem.pull_bot]
  have he : Idem.pull k c = ⊥ := (inf_eq_left.mpr ha).symm.trans hempty
  have he' : Idem.pull k n = ⊥ := (le_antisymm hb ha).trans he
  have hk0 := joint_zero joins c n hcn k
    (by rw [← Idem.pull_commute,he,Idem.bot_hom,zero_comp])
    (by rw [← Idem.pull_commute,he',Idem.bot_hom,zero_comp])
  exact terminal_nonzero hZ hne (hk.symm.trans
    ((congrArg RestrictionCategory.rst hk0).trans (RestrictionZero.restrict_zero Z.obj U)))

include hZ hτ in

theorem terminal_predicate_of_coded_order (hne : ∃ X : C, 𝟙 X ≠ (0 : X ⟶ X))
    (pair : nearProd U U ⟶ U) (d : Idem U)
    (hd : ∀ k j : Z.obj ⟶ U, isTotal k → isTotal j →
      (Idem.pull (partialPairing k j ≫ pair) d = ⊤ ↔
        ArrowLE (program hZ τ k) (program hZ τ j))) :
    ∃ b : Idem Z.obj, b ≠ ⊥ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ := by
  apply exists_nontrivial_terminal_predicate hZ τ hτ hne (Idem.pull pair d)
  intro k j hk hj
  simpa only [Idem.pull_comp] using hd k j hk hj

theorem consequence_iff_provable (T : Set Janiczak.Formula) (p : Janiczak.Formula) :
    Consequence T p ↔ theory T ⊢ sentence p := by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    let _ : 𝗘𝗤 L ⪯ theory T := inferInstanceAs (𝗘𝗤 L ⪯ (𝗘𝗤 L ∪ sentence '' T))
    apply Theory.Proof.complete_on_eq_models.{0,0}
    intro M _ _ _ hM
    let A : Janiczak.Structure := ⟨M, inferInstance, relation⟩
    apply (sentence_models p).mpr
    apply hp A
    intro q hq
    exact (sentence_models q).mp (hM.models _ (Or.inr ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩))
  · intro hp M hM
    let _ :=  M.inhabited
    let _ :=  model M
    let _ :=  equality_in_model M
    exact (sentence_models p).mp (consequence_iff.mp (Theory.Proof.sound hp) M.Carrier
      (translated_models M T hM))

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.t.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.turingObject_iff
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.t.source:
theorem turingObject_iff (U : C) :
    (∀ A B : C, ∃ τ : nearProd U A ⟶ B, IsTuringMorphism τ) ↔
      (∃ τ : nearProd U U ⟶ U, IsTuringMorphism τ) ∧
        ∀ X : C, ∃ (m : X ⟶ U) (r : U ⟶ X), isTotal m ∧ m ≫ r = 𝟙 X := by
  constructor
  · intro typed
    refine ⟨typed U U, ?_⟩
    intro X
    obtain ⟨eval, he⟩ := typed U X
    obtain ⟨m, hm, h⟩ := he X (p0 X U)
    refine ⟨m, diag U ≫ eval, hm, ?_⟩
    have eqn := congrArg (fun k => partialPairing (𝟙 X) m ≫ k) h
    rw [← Category.assoc, PCategory.partialPairing_comp_nearProd_map,
      Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, PCategory.p0_partialPairing_of_isTotal _ hm] at eqn
    rwa [← Category.assoc, PCategory.diag_nat]
  · rintro ⟨⟨τ, hτ⟩, retract⟩ A B
    obtain ⟨mA, rA, _, hrA⟩ := retract A
    obtain ⟨mB, rB, _, hrB⟩ := retract B
    refine ⟨nearProd_map (𝟙 U) mA ≫ τ ≫ rB, ?_⟩
    intro Z f
    obtain ⟨g, hg, h⟩ := hτ Z (nearProd_map (𝟙 Z) rA ≫ f ≫ mB)
    refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
    have swap : nearProd_map g (𝟙 A) ≫ nearProd_map (𝟙 U) mA =
        nearProd_map (𝟙 Z) mA ≫ nearProd_map g (𝟙 U) := by
      simp only [PCategory.nearProd_comp, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    calc
      _ = nearProd_map (𝟙 Z) mA ≫ (nearProd_map g (𝟙 U) ≫ τ) ≫ rB := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, swap]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = f := by
        rw [h]
        have cancel : nearProd_map (𝟙 Z) mA ≫ nearProd_map (𝟙 Z) rA = 𝟙 _ := by
          rw [PCategory.nearProd_comp, Category.comp_id, hrA, PCategory.nearProd_id]
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using
          (show (nearProd_map (𝟙 Z) mA ≫ nearProd_map (𝟙 Z) rA) ≫ f ≫ (mB ≫ rB) = f by
            rw [cancel, hrB, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])

theorem summands_pairComplementary [CoprodStruct C] [CategoryTheory.HasCoproducts C]
    [RestrictionCoproducts C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] [RestrictionZero C]
    (Y Z : C) : PairComplementary (summand0 Y Z) (summand1 Y Z) := by
  refine ⟨summands_disjoint Y Z, ?_⟩
  intro r h₀ h₁
  change (𝟙 (coprod Y Z)) ≫ r.hom = 𝟙 _
  rw [Category.id_comp]
  apply CategoryTheory.HasCoproducts.hom_ext
  · have h := congrArg (fun k => i0 Y Z ≫ k) (Idem.le_def.mp h₀)
    simpa only [← Category.assoc, i0_summand0, Category.comp_id] using h
  · have h := congrArg (fun k => i1 Y Z ≫ k) (Idem.le_def.mp h₁)
    simpa only [← Category.assoc, i1_summand1, Category.comp_id] using h

theorem interpreted_theory_unique_factor (G : RangeFunctor C (Par D)) {P T S : C}
    (c : P ⟶ S) (hc : isTotal c) (m : T ⟶ S) (hm : isTotal m)
    (r : S ⟶ T) (t : Idem S) (ht : t = Ranges.range c)
    (hmr : m ≫ r = 𝟙 T) (hrm : r ≫ m = t.hom)
    {V : D} (v : V ⟶ (G.toFunctor.obj S).obj) [Mono v] (k : (G.toFunctor.obj P).obj ⟶ V)
    (hfac : k ≫ v = totalValue (G.toFunctor.map c) (G.map_total c hc)) :
    ∃! w : (G.toFunctor.obj T).obj ⟶ V,
      w ≫ v = totalValue (G.toFunctor.map m) (G.map_total m hm) := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (interpreted_theory_subobject G c hc m hm r t ht hmr hrm v k hfac).2
  exact ⟨w, hw, fun z hz => (cancel_mono v).mp (hz.trans hw.symm)⟩

theorem right_unit_total_iff (Y : PartialMaps.Par (Over U)) :
    isTotal ((rightAdjunction i inverses).unit.app Y) ↔
      ∃ r : Y.obj.left ⟶ T, r ≫ i = Y.obj.hom := by
  rw [right_unit_span]
  let m := pullbackInclusion i inverses Y
  let s := PartialMaps.Raw.monoInverse m
  change isTotal (PartialMaps.ofSpan s) ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    let : IsIso m := PartialMaps.Raw.left_isIso_of_total s h
    let : IsIso (pullback.fst Y.obj.hom i) := (Over.forget U).map_isIso m
    refine ⟨inv (pullback.fst Y.obj.hom i) ≫ pullback.snd Y.obj.hom i, ?_⟩
    rw [Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  · rintro ⟨r, h⟩
    let e := PartialMaps.pullbackFactorIso Y.obj.hom i r h
    let E : ((postcompose i).obj ((reindex i inverses).obj Y)).obj ≅ Y.obj :=
      Over.isoMk e (pullback.condition (f := Y.obj.hom) (g := i))
    let : IsIso m := E.isIso_hom
    let : IsIso s.l := ‹IsIso m›
    rw [PartialMaps.ofSpan_eq_of_iso (PartialMaps.Raw.totalIso s)]
    exact PartialMaps.ofTotal_total _

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.R.source:
theorem realize_injective : Function.Injective realize := by
  intro X
  induction X with
  | omega =>
    rintro (_ | ⟨A, B⟩ | ⟨A, B⟩) he
    · rfl
    · exact (omega_ne_product _ _ he).elim
    · exact (omega_ne_taggedUnion _ _ he).elim
  | product X Y hX hY =>
    rintro (_ | ⟨A, B⟩ | ⟨A, B⟩) he
    · exact (omega_ne_product _ _ he.symm).elim
    · have h₁ := congrArg firstProjection he
      have h₂ := congrArg secondProjection he
      rw [realize, realize, firstProjection_product _ _ (infinite_realize Y).nonempty,
        firstProjection_product _ _ (infinite_realize B).nonempty] at h₁
      rw [realize, realize, secondProjection_product _ _ (infinite_realize X).nonempty,
        secondProjection_product _ _ (infinite_realize A).nonempty] at h₂
      rw [hX h₁, hY h₂]
    · exact (product_ne_taggedUnion X Y A B he).elim
  | coproduct X Y hX hY =>
    rintro (_ | ⟨A, B⟩ | ⟨A, B⟩) he
    · exact (omega_ne_taggedUnion _ _ he.symm).elim
    · exact (product_ne_taggedUnion A B X Y he.symm).elim
    · obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := taggedUnion_injective he
      rw [hX hl, hY hr]

theorem equal_standard_axioms_unprovable :
    ∃ e : ℕ, e ≠ Kleene.emptyIndex ∧ standardAxioms e = standardAxioms Kleene.emptyIndex ∧
      ¬ 𝗣𝗔 ⊢ equivalenceSentence e Kleene.emptyIndex := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ c : Code, ¬ (c.eval 0).Dom ∧ ¬ 𝗣𝗔 ⊢ equivalenceSentence (waitIndex c) Kleene.emptyIndex := by
    by_contra! hall
    apply ComputablePred.halting_problem_not_re 0
    apply ((provable_equivalence_enumerable Kleene.emptyIndex).comp waitIndex_computable).of_eq
    intro c
    exact ⟨fun hp => (equal_standard_iff c).mp (sound_equivalence hp), hall c⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hp⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨waitIndex c, ?_, (equal_standard_iff c).mpr hc, hp⟩
  intro he
  apply hp
  rw [he]
  apply complete.{0} 𝗣𝗔
  intro M _ _
  exact (equivalence_models _ _).mpr fun _ => Iff.rfl

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.I.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.IndexedAxiomPresentations.Checks.indexed_axiom_presentations
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.I.source:
theorem indexed_axiom_presentations :
    let Ax := axiomGraph axiomCodes
    ∃ e d : ℕ, e ≠ d ∧
      (∀ w : ℕ, Ax.val.Evalb ![e,w] ↔ axiomCodes.val.Evalb ![w]) ∧
      (∀ w : ℕ, Ax.val.Evalb ![d,w] ↔ axiomCodes.val.Evalb ![w]) ∧
      ¬ 𝗣𝗔 ⊢ “∀ z, !Ax.val !!e z ↔ !Ax.val !!d z” := by
  let Ax := axiomGraph axiomCodes
  have hf (k w : ℕ) : Ax.val.Evalb ![k,w] ↔ w ∈ standardAxioms k := by
    simp [Ax, standardAxioms, axiomPredicate, fiberAxioms, numeral_eq_natCast_app]
  obtain ⟨e, hne, heq, hnot⟩ := equal_standard_axioms_unprovable
  let d := FailureOfComposition.Kleene.emptyIndex
  refine ⟨e,d,hne,fun w => (hf e w).trans ?_, fun w => (hf d w).trans (emptyIndex_axioms w), ?_⟩
  · rw [heq, emptyIndex_axioms]
  · intro h
    apply hnot
    apply complete.{0} 𝗣𝗔
    intro M _ _
    have hM := consequence_iff.mp (Theory.Proof.sound h) M inferInstance
    simpa [models_iff, equivalenceSentence, axiomPredicate, fiberAxioms, Ax, d] using hM

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.A.source:
theorem uniform_independent_sentences :
    ∃ q : ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.parameter ⟶ ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.sentence,
      ∀ e : ℕ, Entailment.Consistent (ArithmeticNamedProofConnectives.system (gamma e)) →
        ∃ φ : Formula, φ.freeVariables = [] ∧
          formulaCode φ =
            ((PredicateInterpretation.canonicalDomainFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map q
              (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 ℕ e)).val.val ∧
          ¬ SyntacticNamedHilbert.Derives functionSymbols relationSymbols bound (gamma e) φ ∧
          ¬ SyntacticNamedHilbert.Derives functionSymbols relationSymbols bound (gamma e) (.neg φ) := by
  refine ⟨sentence,?_⟩
  intro e hc
  let φ := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.instanceFormula ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (output e)
  have hr := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.standard_instance_result ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (output e)
  obtain ⟨hclosed,hpos,hneg⟩ := independent_instance e hc
  exact ⟨φ,hclosed,hr.1.symm.trans (sentence_value e).symm,hpos,hneg⟩

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.N.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedTheoryObservations.ofEnumerableTheory
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.N.source:
def ofEnumerableTheory (T : Set ℕ) (hT : REPred (· ∈ T))
    (hs : ∀ w ∈ T, ∃ φ : Formula, φ.freeVariables = [] ∧ formulaCode φ = w)
    (hPA : ∀ φ, ArithmeticNamedAxiomComparison.PAAxiom φ → formulaCode φ ∈ T)
    (hd : ∀ φ : Formula, φ.freeVariables = [] → FiniteDerivation (axiomPredicate T) φ → formulaCode φ ∈ T)
    (hc : SentenceConsistent T) : Theory := by
  refine ⟨T, ⟨axiomPredicate T, ?_, ?_⟩, hc⟩
  · intro φ hφ
    exact .axiom φ ((axiomPredicate_eval T hT _).mpr (hPA φ hφ)) hφ.1
  · ext w
    constructor
    · intro hw
      obtain ⟨φ, hφ, rfl⟩ := hs w hw
      apply (theoremSet_iff_eval (axiomPredicate T) (formulaCode φ)).mpr
      exact SyntacticNamedHilbert.native_sentence_theorem functionSymbols relationSymbols bound (axiomPredicate T)
        (.axiom φ ((axiomPredicate_eval T hT _).mpr hw) hφ) hφ
    · intro hw
      obtain ⟨φ, hφ, rfl⟩ := theoremSet_sentences (axiomPredicate T) hw

          Idem.pull (𝟙 ClassicalPrograms.U) (ClassicalPrograms.supportIdem (positive U) (positive_enumerable U))

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.P.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Precomplete.inseparable_unions
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.P.source:
theorem Precomplete.inseparable_unions {R : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (pre : Precomplete R)
    {U V : Set ℕ} (hU : U.Nonempty) (hV : V.Nonempty) (dis : Disjoint U V)
    (satU : ∀ x y, R x y → y ∈ U → x ∈ U) (satV : ∀ x y, R x y → y ∈ V → x ∈ V) :
    Numerical.RecursivelyInseparable U V := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hU
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hV
  refine ⟨dis, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨D, hD, hUD, hDV⟩
  let diag (n : ℕ) := (ofNat Code n).eval n
  have hd : Partrec diag := Code.eval_part.comp ((Computable.ofNat Code).comp Computable.id)
    Computable.id
  obtain ⟨h, hh, totalize⟩ := pre diag hd
  obtain ⟨dec, hdec, hset⟩ := ComputablePred.computable_iff.mp hD
  let flip (n : ℕ) := cond (dec (h n)) b a
  have hf : Computable flip := (hdec.comp hh).cond (Computable.const b) (Computable.const a)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Code.exists_code.mp (Partrec.nat_iff.mp hf.partrec)
  let k := encode c
  have hdiag : flip k ∈ diag k := by
    change flip k ∈ (ofNat Code (encode c)).eval k
    rw [ofNat_encode, hc]
    exact Part.mem_some _
  have hr := totalize k (flip k) hdiag
  have hm : h k ∈ D ↔ dec (h k) = true := (congrFun hset (h k)).to_iff
  cases he : dec (h k) with
  | false =>
    have hu := satU (h k) a (by simpa [flip, he] using hr) ha
    simpa [he] using hm.mp (hUD hu)
  | true =>
    have hv := satV (h k) b (by simpa [flip, he] using hr) hb
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDV (hm.mpr he) hv

theorem proof_search_domains (e : ℕ)
    (hc : Entailment.Consistent (ArithmeticNamedProofConnectives.system (gamma e))) (x : ℕ) :
    (Sum.inl x ∈ (F).map (lift Cpos Cneg) (e,x) ↔ (Cneg).val.Evalb ![e,x]) ∧
    (Sum.inr x ∈ (F).map (lift Cpos Cneg) (e,x) ↔ (Cpos).val.Evalb ![e,x]) := by
  have hd := fiber_disjoint e hc
  have hneg := negative_lift_value ℕ Cpos Cneg e hd x
  have hpos := positive_lift_value ℕ Cpos Cneg e hd x
  have hdom := (model_lift_domain ℕ Cpos Cneg e x).mp
  constructor
  · refine ⟨fun hy => ?_, hneg⟩
    rcases hdom ⟨Sum.inl x, hy⟩ with hp | hn
    · have he : (Sum.inl x : ℕ ⊕ ℕ) = Sum.inr x := Part.mem_unique hy (hpos hp)
      cases he
    · exact hn
  · refine ⟨fun hy => ?_, hpos⟩
    rcases hdom ⟨Sum.inr x, hy⟩ with hp | hn
    · exact hp
    · have he : (Sum.inl x : ℕ ⊕ ℕ) = Sum.inr x := Part.mem_unique (hneg hn) hy
      cases he

theorem uniform_finite_derivations (e : ℕ)
    (hc : Entailment.Consistent (ArithmeticNamedProofConnectives.system (gamma e))) :
    let n := ArithmeticUniformIndependent.output e
    let φ := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.instanceFormula ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val n
    (F).map ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.sourceParityDiagonal n = (F).map (lift Cpos Cneg) (e,n) ∧
      (¬ ∃ y : ℕ ⊕ ℕ, y ∈ (F).map (lift Cpos Cneg) (e,n)) ∧
      ¬ NamedTheoryObservations.FiniteDerivation (gamma e) φ ∧
      ¬ NamedTheoryObservations.FiniteDerivation (gamma e) (.neg φ) := by
  let n := ArithmeticUniformIndependent.output e
  let φ := NamedTheoryObservations.numeralInstance n
  have hφ : φ.freeVariables = [] := NamedTheoryObservations.numeralInstance_closed n
  have hav := output_avoids e hc
  refine ⟨diagonal_partial_value Cpos Cneg e n (output_mem ℕ Cpos Cneg e),
    fun hy => ((model_lift_domain ℕ Cpos Cneg e n).mp hy).elim hav.1 hav.2, ?_⟩
  have hw : ((PredicateInterpretation.canonicalDomainFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map
      ArithmeticUniformIndependent.sentence (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 ℕ e)).val.val =
      NamedArithmeticSignature.formulaCode φ :=
    (sentence_value e).trans (NamedTheoryObservations.positiveWord_eq n)
  have hs := sentence_code_avoids e hc
  dsimp only at hs
  rw [hw, NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord_formulaCode] at hs
  exact ⟨fun h => hs.1 ((NamedTheoryObservations.theoremSet_iff_eval (gamma e) _).mp
      ((NamedTheoryObservations.theoremSet_iff_finiteDerivation (gamma e) φ hφ).mpr h)),
    fun h => hs.2 ((NamedTheoryObservations.theoremSet_iff_eval (gamma e) _).mp
      ((NamedTheoryObservations.theoremSet_iff_finiteDerivation (gamma e) (.neg φ) hφ).mpr h))⟩

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.M.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.exists_coordinate_fixedPoint
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.M.source:
theorem exists_coordinate_fixedPoint (J : ℕ → Point → Set UnitInterval)
    (hg : ∀ d, IsClosed {z : Point × UnitInterval | z.2 ∈ J d z.1})
    (hb : ∀ d a, ∃ l u : UnitInterval, l ≤ u ∧ J d a = Icc l u) :
    ∃ a : Point, ∀ d, a d ∈ J d a := by
  let D (m : ℕ) : Set Point := {a | ∀ d < m, a d ∈ J d a}
  have hd (m : ℕ) : IsClosed (D m) := by
    have he : D m = ⋂ i : Fin m, {a : Point | a i ∈ J i a} := by
      ext a
      simp only [D, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_iInter, Fin.forall_iff]
    rw [he]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i => (hg i).preimage (continuous_id.prodMk (continuous_apply i.val))
  have hn (m : ℕ) : (D m).Nonempty := finite_coordinate_fixedPoint J hg hb m
  have hs (m : ℕ) : D (m+1) ⊆ D m := fun _ h d hd => h d (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hd)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_sequence_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed D
    hs hn (hd 0).isCompact hd
  exact ⟨a, fun d => mem_iInter.mp ha (d+1) d (Nat.lt_succ_self d)⟩

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.M.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.Cut.Distance.isOpen_iff_productDistance
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.M.source:
theorem isOpen_iff_productDistance (s : Set Point) :
    IsOpen s ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ ε > 0, ∀ y, productDistance x y < ε → y ∈ s := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hs x hx
    by_cases hn : (sᶜ).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hm⟩ :=
        hs.isClosed_compl.isCompact.exists_isMinOn hn (continuous_productDistance x).continuousOn
      refine ⟨productDistance x y, positive_distance (fun h => hy (h ▸ hx)), ?_⟩
      intro w hw
      by_contra h
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (hm h)) hw
    · exact ⟨1, zero_lt_one, fun y _ => by by_contra h; exact hn ⟨y, h⟩⟩
  · intro h
    apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := h x hx
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset ((isOpen_lt (continuous_productDistance x) continuous_const).mem_nhds
      (show productDistance x x < ε by simpa [productDistance] using hε)) (fun y hy => hsub y hy)

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.M.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.Cut.Distance.weightedMetric
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.M.source:
@[instance_reducible] def weightedMetric : MetricSpace Point := MetricSpace.ofDistTopology productDistance
  (fun x => by simp [productDistance])
  (fun x y => by unfold productDistance
                 exact tsum_congr fun n => congrArg (Series.weight n * ·) (abs_sub_comm (x n : ℝ) (y n : ℝ)))
  (fun x y z => by
    let δ (a b : Point) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := Series.weight n * |(a n : ℝ) - b n|
    have summable (a b : Point) : Summable (δ a b) :=
      Series.value_summable (fun n (w : Point) => |(a n : ℝ) - (w n : ℝ)|) (fun n w => coordinate_bounds n a w) b
    change (∑' n, δ x z n) ≤ (∑' n, δ x y n) + ∑' n, δ y z n
    rw [← (summable x y).tsum_add (summable y z)]
    exact (summable x z).tsum_mono ((summable x y).add (summable y z))
      (fun n => by simpa [δ, mul_add] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_sub_le (x n : ℝ) (y n) (z n)) (Series.weight_nonneg n)))
  isOpen_iff_productDistance
  (fun _ _ h => Classical.byContradiction fun ne => (positive_distance ne).ne' h)

theorem integer_cut_axioms (a : Point) (n : ℕ) (u : ℤ) (v : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) :
    ((u : ℝ) / (v : ℝ) < (a n : ℝ) →
      formulaCode (lt (integerTerm (Rationals.integerCode u)) (mul (natural v) (c n))) ∈
        cutAxioms a) ∧
    ((a n : ℝ) < (u : ℝ) / (v : ℝ) →
      formulaCode (lt (mul (natural v) (c n)) (integerTerm (Rationals.integerCode u))) ∈
        cutAxioms a) := by
  let j := Nat.pair (Rationals.integerCode u) (v - 1)
  have hv' : v - 1 + 1 = v := Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hv)
  have hq : (Rationals.q j : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) / (v : ℝ) := by
    simp only [j, Rationals.q, Nat.unpair_pair, Rationals.signed_integerCode, hv',
      Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast, Rat.cast_natCast]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine Or.inl ⟨n, j, by simpa only [hq] using h, ?_⟩
    simpa only [belowSentence, j, Nat.unpair_pair, hv'] using (formulaCode_belowSentence n j).symm
  · intro h
    refine Or.inr ⟨n, j, by simpa only [hq] using h, ?_⟩
    simpa only [aboveSentence, j, Nat.unpair_pair, hv'] using (formulaCode_aboveSentence n j).symm

theorem existsUnique_gluing {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f g : C(SierpinskiPoint, Y)) (agree : f openPoint = g openPoint) :
    ∃! h : C(Point, Y), (∀ x, h (inclusion false x) = f x) ∧
      (∀ x, h (inclusion true x) = g x) := by
  let h : Point → Y
    | .a => f closedPoint
    | .b => g closedPoint

  have hh : Continuous h := by
    apply continuous_def.mpr
    intro u hu
    have hf : f closedPoint ∈ u → f openPoint ∈ u := hu.preimage f.continuous
    have hg : g closedPoint ∈ u → g openPoint ∈ u := hu.preimage g.continuous
    change (f closedPoint ∈ u → f openPoint ∈ u) ∧ (g closedPoint ∈ u → f openPoint ∈ u)
    exact ⟨hf, fun hgu => agree.symm ▸ hg hgu⟩
  refine ⟨⟨h, hh⟩, ⟨(fun x => by cases x <;> rfl), (fun x => by cases x; rfl; exact agree)⟩, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  cases x
  · exact hk.1 closedPoint
  · exact hk.2 closedPoint
  · exact hk.1 openPoint

    Graph (endpointParameter f) z q ↔ q.val = (0, endpointIndex f (NumericalTuples.code _ z.val)) := by
  unfold Graph endpointParameter
  rw [tupleCode.map_preimage, EnumerableCarriers.mem_val_comp]
  change (∃ n, n ∈ val (EffectiveFork.endpointEncoding _ _) _ ∧ _ ∈ val endpointIso.inv n) ↔ _
  simp only [labelCode_inv, exists_eq_right']
  rw [EffectiveFork.mem_endpointEncoding]
  have hs := z.property
  have hc := (NumericalTuples.code_mem_codedSupport Z.obj z.val).mpr hs
  change _ ∈ NumericalTuples.codedSupport Z.obj ∧ _ = _ ↔ _
  rw [and_iff_right hc]
  change NumericalTuples.code 2 q.val =
    NumericalTuples.code 2 (0, endpointIndex f (NumericalTuples.code _ z.val)) ↔ _
  exact (NumericalTuples.code_injective 2).eq_iff

      (∀ (z : Point (Y.obj.obj .left)) (q : Point (tupleSpace 2)),
        Graph ((evaluation .left).map c) z q ↔ q.val = (0, componentIndex f .left (code _ z.val))) ∧
      (∀ (z : Point (Y.obj.obj .right)) (q : Point (tupleSpace 2)),
        Graph ((evaluation .right).map c) z q ↔ q.val = (0, componentIndex f .right (code _ z.val))) ∧
      (∀ (z : Point (Y.obj.obj .zero)) (q : Point (tupleSpace 4)),
        Graph ((evaluation .zero).map c) z q ↔
          q.val = (0, componentIndex f .zero (code _ z.val),
            componentIndex f .left (code _ ((Y.obj.map WalkingSpan.Hom.fst).toFun z).val),
            componentIndex f .right (code _ ((Y.obj.map WalkingSpan.Hom.snd).toFun z).val))) ∧
      (∀ (j : WalkingSpan), Computable (fun z : Tuple (Y.obj.obj j).dimension =>
        componentIndex f j (code _ z))) ∧
      (∀ (j : WalkingSpan) (z : Point (Y.obj.obj j)) (x w : Point (universal.obj.obj j)),
        code _ w.val ∈ eval (componentIndex f j (code _ z.val)) (code _ x.val) ↔

  ⟨forkParameter f, forkParameter_total f, fork_parameterizes f, forkParameter_left f,

theorem tuple_signed_atoms_mono (a b : Idem EffectiveFork.V) :
    Mono (coprod.desc
      (NumericalForkPartialMaps.totalEquivalence.inverse.map (axiomInclusion a ≫ atom))
      (NumericalForkPartialMaps.totalEquivalence.inverse.map (axiomInclusion b ≫ atom ≫ negation))) := by

theorem endpoint_undecided_atom (i : Bool) (t : Idem natCarrier)
    (ht : endpointTheory i categoricalTheory ≤ t)
    (hc : t ⊓ Idem.pull (natArrow negCode negCode_computable) t = ⊥) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, atomCode k ∉ support t ∧ negCode (atomCode k) ∉ support t := by
  classical
  let θ := natArrow atomCode atomCode_computable
  let ν := natArrow negCode negCode_computable
  let p := Idem.pull θ t
  let n := Idem.pull θ (Idem.pull ν t)
  obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := observed_bounds i categoricalTheory le_rfl
  have h : Inseparable p n := EffectiveFork.endpoint_pair_inseparable.enlarge
    (ha.trans (Idem.pull_mono θ ht)) (hb.trans (Idem.pull_mono θ (Idem.pull_mono ν ht)))
    (by change Idem.pull θ _ ⊓ Idem.pull θ _ = _; rw [← Idem.pull_inf, hc, Idem.pull_bot])
  have pos (k : ℕ) : k ∈ support p ↔ atomCode k ∈ support t := by
    change k ∈ support (Idem.pull θ t) ↔ _
    rw [EnumerableCarriers.support_pull]
    simp only [θ, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, mem_natArrow, exists_eq_left]
  have neg (k : ℕ) : k ∈ support n ↔ negCode (atomCode k) ∈ support t := by
    simp only [n, θ, ν, EnumerableCarriers.support_pull, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, mem_natArrow, exists_eq_left]
  by_contra! all
  have cover : p ⊔ n = ⊤ := by
    apply EnumerableCarriers.support_injective
    rw [EnumerableCarriers.support_sup, EnumerableCarriers.support_top]
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro k
    by_cases hk : atomCode k ∈ support t
    · exact Or.inl ((pos k).mpr hk)
    · exact Or.inr ((neg k).mpr (all k hk))
  exact h.no_separator ⟨p, n, ⟨h.disjoint, cover⟩, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩

theorem leftMap_injective_of_decidableVariables {X : EffectiveFork.Total} (E : DecidableVariables X)
    {x y u : ℕ} (hx : u ∈ EnumerableCarriers.val X.obj.leftMap x)
    (hy : u ∈ EnumerableCarriers.val X.obj.leftMap y) : x = y := by
  have sx := EnumerableCarriers.val_source _ _ _ hx
  have sy := EnumerableCarriers.val_source _ _ _ hy
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Part.dom_iff_mem.mp
    ((EnumerableCarriers.total_iff _).mp X.obj.right_total x sx)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Part.dom_iff_mem.mp
    ((EnumerableCarriers.total_iff _).mp X.obj.right_total y sy)
  let p : centerProbe ⟶ X := ⟨point0 x u v sx hx hv, point0_total x u v sx hx hv⟩
  let q : centerProbe ⟶ X := ⟨point0 y u w sy hy hw, point0_total y u w sy hy hw⟩
  have hleft : leftInclusion ≫ p = leftInclusion ≫ q := by
    apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
    apply EffectiveFork.Hom.ext
    · exact (empty_arrow_zero _).trans (empty_arrow_zero _).symm
    · rfl
    · exact (empty_arrow_zero _).trans (empty_arrow_zero _).symm
  have h : p = q := by
    apply (E.test_true_iff _ _).mp
    apply precompose_left_boolean
    rw [← Category.assoc, prod.comp_lift, Two.comp_constant]
    exact (E.test_true_iff _ _).mpr hleft
  have hc := congrArg (fun f : centerProbe ⟶ X => EnumerableCarriers.val f.hom.center 0) h
  change EnumerableCarriers.val (constant x sx : singletonCarrier ⟶ X.obj.center) 0 =
    EnumerableCarriers.val (constant y sy : singletonCarrier ⟶ X.obj.center) 0 at hc
  rw [val_constant_at _ _ 0 (by rfl), val_constant_at _ _ 0 (by rfl)] at hc
  exact Part.some_injective hc

theorem connected_le_numeral [T.RE] (a : Idem (omegaObject T)) (hc : Connected a) (hne : a ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n, a ≤ predicateIdem T (numeralPredicate n) := by
  obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ := omegaIdem_is_predicate T a
  simp_rw [predicate_le]
  by_contra hn
  have hre (j : ℕ) : REPred (· ∈ decisions T C j) :=
    SyntacticModel.numeral_provability_enumerable T (decisionFormula C j)
  have hrec : ComputablePred (· ∈ decisions T C 1) :=
    ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re'.mpr
      ⟨hre 1, (hre 0).of_eq (decisions_complement T C hc hne)⟩
  apply ArithmeticSentenceInseparability.diagonal_no_recursive_separator
  refine ⟨decisions T C 1, hrec, ?_, Set.disjoint_left.mpr ?_⟩
  · intro n ha
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (alpha_iff_stage (M := ℕ) n).mp ha
    apply (decision_iff T C 1 n).mpr
    intro M _ _ x hx
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    exact (stageAt_eval 1 n x).mpr (stageParity_mono _ _ _
      (bounds_of_no_numeral T C hc hn t M x hx) (standard_stage n t ht))
  · intro n hp hb
    have hneg := ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta_numeral_refutes_alpha n hb
    have h1 := (decision_iff T C 1 n).mp hp
    apply hne (predicate_bot T C ?_)
    intro M _ _ x hx
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    have hh := consequence_iff.mp (Theory.Proof.sound hneg) M inferInstance
    rw [Semantics.Not.models_not, ClassicalPrograms.numeralInstance_eval] at hh
    exact hh ((alpha_iff_stage _).mpr ⟨x, (stageAt_eval 1 n x).mp (h1 M x hx)⟩)

theorem indistinguishable_on_connected [Consistent T] (hT : REPred (AxiomCodes T)) :
    ∃ f g : omegaObject T ⟶ omegaObject T, f ≠ g ∧
      ∀ a : Idem (omegaObject T), Connected a → a.hom ≫ f = a.hom ≫ g := by
  let : T.RE := ⟨(hT.comp Computable.encode).of_eq (fun σ => by
    simp only [AxiomCodes, Sentence.quote_eq_encode_nat, Encodable.encode_inj]
    simp)⟩
  obtain ⟨e, f, g, hef, hcomp⟩ := index_noncongruence_via_godel_of_re_axioms T hT
  refine ⟨omegaArrow T (classOf T e), omegaArrow T (classOf T f), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro he
    have h := congrArg (fun k : omegaObject T ⟶ omegaObject T => k.val * classOf T g) he
    exact hcomp (pointwise_of_class_eq T h)
  · intro a ha
    by_cases hz : a = ⊥
    · subst a
      simp
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := connected_le_numeral T a ha hz
      exact comp_eq_of_supported _ _ (Idem.le_def.mp hn) _ _ (numeral_restriction_eq T hef n)

def normalization : IsoCat (CodedProgramCategory T) (NormalizedCategory T) where
  functor := comparison T
  inverse := guarded T
  unit_eq := by
    refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) ?_
    intro X Y f
    simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
    change f = (isoToOmega T (objectCode X)).hom ≫
      ((isoToOmega T (objectCode X)).inv ≫ f ≫ (isoToOmega T (objectCode Y)).hom) ≫
      (isoToOmega T (objectCode Y)).inv
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  counit_eq := by
    refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) ?_
    intro X Y f
    simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
    apply InducedCategory.hom_ext
    change (isoToOmega T X).inv ≫ ((isoToOmega T X).hom ≫ f.hom ≫ (isoToOmega T Y).inv) ≫
      (isoToOmega T Y).hom = f.hom
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

theorem observation_extension (T' : ArithmeticTheory) [𝗣𝗔 ⪯ T'] [T ⪯ T']
    (c : Idem (omegaObject T)) :
    observation T c ⊆ observation T' ((SyntacticExtension.rangeFunctor T T').mapIdem c) := by
  intro n hn
  change kappa T n ≫ c.hom = kappa T n at hn
  have h := congrArg (SyntacticExtension.functor T T').map hn
  rw [Functor.map_comp] at h
  have hk : (SyntacticExtension.functor T T').map (kappa T n) = kappa T' n :=
    SyntacticExtension.map_index T T' .omega .omega (UniformRange.rangeConstantIndex n)
  rw [hk] at h
  exact h
